title: RigRequest
description: Params in for the rig layer: one GLB by reference plus what kind of thing it is.

glb.description: Reference to a GLB on the shared filesystem. Shape-compatible with image2mesh's MeshResult.glb.

subject.description: humanoid fits a skeleton to the mesh and skins it. prop adds no armature at all: the node itself is animated and an optional socket empty marks an attachment point, which is what a game engine wants from a barrel.

animations.description: Clips to author. humanoid: idle, walk, run, jump. prop: spin, bob. Omit for the whole default set (all four for a humanoid, spin for a prop).

socket.description: prop only. Name for an empty parented to the mesh, exported as a node a caller can attach to. glTF has no socket concept, so a named node is the convention.

outDir.description: Where the rigged GLB lands. Defaults to the input's directory.

blenderPath.description: Blender executable. Omit to search $BLENDER, /home/hec/opt/blender-5.2.0-linux-x64/blender, then PATH.
